source.comparison: UI comparisons use complete parsed objects from the actual installed archive and the full official ZIP; raw hashes differ because installed UI is compiled/minified. All seven PNGs are byte-equal in the ZIP, local install and pinned official raw URLs.

coordinateConvention: All game rectangles are [x,y,width,height], relative to common.root_panel176x166. CSS rectangles multiply every value by2, retaining source fractions. Anchors are stated when the source label has natural text size.

title.formula: titlePanel bottom_middle offset[0,3]. Text natural width/height are not declared in anvil.generic_label; render with the library normal-font profile.

icon.note: Physical PNG15x15 is intentionally displayed30x30game, a4x nearest-neighbor raster enlargement at GUI2.

nameField.formula: text_edit_panel bottom_left size[100%,70%], offset[0,2] => titleAndText.y+27.6-19.32+2. anvil.text_edit_control inherits full parent size; it does not declare a generic fixed control height.

result.note: Normal18game container, not the26game furnace result.

elements.slotFormula: recipeGrid grid_dimensions[5,1] => cell26.892x16.56game. Direct fixed18x18 anvil_item_slot wrappers occupy cell origins0/2/4: x=20.77+column*26.892; y=47.02. Only the inner common.container_item has explicit center anchors, acting within its18x18 wrapper. The prior wrapper-centering assumption is withdrawn; see verification.slotGeometryCorrection.

arrow.formula: Center the18x12 logical image box in cell3. Intrinsic22x15 arrow_large.png uses contain, painting17.6x12 with horizontal inset0.2. gameRect/cssRect here describe the box, not stretched artwork.

invalid.source: anvil.cross_out_icon, layer1, visibility #cross_out_icon. Underlying arrow remains present. Logical box18x12 contains original15x15 artwork as12x12, horizontally inset3; gameRect/cssRect are the box.

cost.formula: recipePanel bottom_right offset[0,0]; width is natural text width.

background.note: Original2x2 Gray PNG is black, despite its filename; use the actual texture.

typographyAndInput.sourceNormal: anvil.generic_label does not override font_size; common.text_edit_box sets normal. Later finite captured Anvil role metrics and explicit caller profiles are documented in ANVIL_IMAGE_QA.md; no unique general normal-font selection/baseline algorithm is recovered.
typographyAndInput.webProfile: The existing library profile uses var(--mc-font-size),20px line-height and the selected --mc-font. Mojangles calibration is independent of native default font-size/baseline acceptance.

editText.source: anvil.text_edit_control overrides label size[default,10], common.text_edit_box uses text_box_text_color and shadowfalse.

editClipper.formula: common.text_edit_box centering_panel size[100%-6px,100%-4px] centered. Label minimum width100%, right_middle anchors and10game label height => centered20CSS text strip inside that clipper.
editClipper.implementation: The semantic HTML input uses a20CSSpx text strip, left6px,width100%-12px; horizontal scroll/caret are browser behavior, not a recovered native editor.
editClipper.optionalSourcePolicy: Anvil name clipQuantization must explicitly select floor-min-ceil-max or logical-stage-floor. The latter uses float32(frame/ceilStage) per-axis ratios, float32 global-edge products and floors all four physical edges. QA/Long observed LTRB1057,400,1675,476; only these finite frames and source candidates are compared, not general engine restoration.

disabled.source: common.text_edit_box locked state with disabled_alpha. renameDisabled is caller-provided, not inferred from input occupancy.

typographyAndInput.readonly: renameReadOnly is a Web affordance with no separate native visual state; browser readOnly is forwarded.
typographyAndInput.webCostShadow: CSS shadow offset2x2 represents1game pixel and uses quarter RGB tint. Source proves shadowtrue, but does not prove the native shadow shader tint or rasterization; this choice needs native capture.

focus.nameField: No explicit source directional focus overrides. Browser arrow keys retain normal caret editing; Tab follows DOM order rather than claiming native gamepad navigation.
focus.unavailableResult: Result remains focusable and hoverable; ResultSlot blocks taking empty, invalid, unaffordable, too-expensive, or malformed numeric-cost states.

costApi.levels: {kind:levels,levels:number,affordable?:boolean,label?:string}; finite nonnegative values format as Enchantment Cost: plus truncated integer, matching source English %1$d formatting. Negative or nonfinite levels do not render a cost and disable result taking.
costApi.tooExpensive: {kind:too-expensive,label?:string}; default Too Expensive!, source failure red and result unavailable.
costApi.none: null or undefined hides cost. No level threshold, rename cost, recipe or transfer is computed.
costApi.localizedLabels: title, renameLabel and cost.label are caller-provided overrides; source English translations are Repair & Name, Enchantment Cost: %1$d, Too Expensive!.

closeButton: Source anvil_panel inherits common.common_panel with show_close_button defaulttrue. WorkstationFrame onClose remains optional and caller-controlled; unlike the furnace/crafting right-pane profile, Anvil does not suppress it.

verification.independentQa: Historical10/10 PASS and combined Anvil/container18/18 in45.1s are retained as observed runs, not validation of the corrected slot oracle. The historical geometry oracle shared the incorrect wrapper-centering assumption. Four canonical icon/plus/arrow/invalid renders matched independently displayed original PNGs with zero differing RGBA pixels; those source/browser checks are not native whole-GUI equality.

slotGeometryCorrection.basis: Actual QA/Long/Empty GUI5 captures each have39 slots with9 slices and identical first-three packed bounds. QA CL852/RT136 Global67 is pinned below. They reject centered-wrapper placement. A separate CPU source-formula audit matches used XY/UV/indices/MVP with float32 physical multiplication, floor-origin/ceil-extent and half packing; this is not whole-GUI pixel or unique CPU-algorithm certification.
slotGeometryCorrection.note: Packed material width18.125 remains a quantized observation, not a source-size change. Arrow logical box18x12 is distinct from contain paint17.6x12 and packed width17.5. Plus source rectangle remains unchanged. Original three-state extraction and CPU audits are separate from production pixel validation.
slotGeometryCorrection.withdrawnFormula: x=20.77+column*26.892+(26.892-18)/2; y=47.02+(16.56-18)/2. Child center anchors were incorrectly applied to the outer grid wrapper.

imageAspectCorrection.withdrawn: Anvil arrow/cross direct18x12 stretch and historical original-PNG stretch self-comparisons did not establish native image aspect behavior. This correction does not extend to Smithing.
imageAspectCorrection.scope: Captured original15x15 texture/fullUV/POINT/Tint1 produces12x12 packed artwork. Normal contain in the18x12 source box supports this observation; no production FBO/full-GUI pass is asserted.

evidenceLimits: Source geometry, texture equality, Web rendered bounds and native game GPU capture are distinct evidence levels.
Fractional source percentages are retained. The finite source-formula/f32/half candidate matches observed attributes; a unique native engine snapping algorithm for arbitrary inputs is unverified.
Default normal font scale, glyph baseline, selected-text/caret appearance, colored cost-shadow shader tint and the disabled edit box composite require same-state native screenshots.

The initial source/browser study claimed no native whole-screen acceptance. Later four explicit unfocused GUI5 UI targets match complete native RGBA as scoped in ANVIL_IMAGE_QA.md; default CSS/font, arbitrary ratios, active native editing, cross-GPU and world/Present remain uncertified.
